settings.seo_title: The Brewtanist | Café and roastery in Prachinburi
settings.seo_description: Visit The Brewtanist at the Khlong Rang Shell station on Route 304 in Si Maha Phot. We roast the beans for our espresso and pour-over coffee and bake our own scones, croissants and cakes.

home.hero_title:
We roast coffee
in Si Maha Phot
home.hero_text: You’ll find our café at the Khlong Rang Shell station on Route 304 in Prachinburi. Stop for a coffee at the bar or take a bag of beans home.
home.hero_alt: The two-storey Brewtanist café, with a wooden balcony above and the coffee bar visible through the ground-floor windows
home.story_title:
Where does the name
Brewtanist come from?
home.story_text:
We love coffee and plants. Put “brew” and “botanist” together and you get Brewtanist.

We choose our beans, roast them and try different ways to brew them until we find a cup we love. If you’re wondering what to order, tell us what you usually drink or which flavours you’d like to try.
home.story_alt: The coffee bar and espresso machine inside Brewtanist
home.visit_text: Park at the Shell station and walk over to the café. There’s seating on both floors and WiFi if you’re bringing your laptop. You can pick out a bag of beans at the bar before you go.
home.visit_alt: The front of Brewtanist café at the Khlong Rang Shell station

coffee.title: What would you like to drink?
coffee.description: Do you like a bold espresso, something fruity or coffee with milk? Tell our baristas how you take your coffee and they’ll help you choose.

cards.label: Espresso
cards.title: House blends
cards.text: Choose Mr. Plantman, Mr. Ozmo or Ms. Lazybug for your espresso. Each of our house blends has its own roast level and flavour.
cards.alt: Coffee grinders and Brewtanist house blends at the bar

cards.label: Pour-over
cards.title: Single-origin coffee
cards.text: We change the beans on our pour-over menu regularly. Ask at the bar what we’re brewing today.

cards.label: Beyond coffee
cards.title: Matcha and pastries
cards.text: Have a matcha with a scone, a croissant or a slice of cake. We bake them here, and the selection changes from day to day.
cards.alt: Drinks and baked goods at Brewtanist

products.title: Our house blends
products.description: Mr. Plantman has rich dark chocolate notes, Mr. Ozmo has the sweetness of vanilla, and Ms. Lazybug is light and floral with a hint of fruit.
products.note: We also sell single-origin coffee, drip bags and coffee capsules. Browse our Shopee shop or ask at the bar what’s available.

items.name: Mr. Plantman
items.description: Dark chocolate, caramel and nutty notes make this a bold cup, whether you drink it black or with milk.
items.alt: Illustration of the gold Mr. Plantman coffee bag

items.name: Mr. Ozmo

items.alt: Illustration of the Mr. Ozmo coffee bag

items.name: Ms. Lazybug

products.finder_text: Answer three questions about how you brew and what you like to drink.

roastery.title: Inside our roastery
roastery.description: We roast our house blends and single-origin coffee for the café and for you to brew at home. After roasting, we taste each coffee and adjust how we brew it.

steps.title: Choosing the beans
steps.text: We look for green coffee with flavours we want to explore and try different ways to bring them out in the cup.

steps.title: Roasting
steps.text: We taste for sweetness, acidity, aroma and body, then adjust the roast.

steps.title: Brewing at the bar
steps.text: Before a coffee goes on the menu, we brew it several times and fine-tune the recipe.

gallery.title: Around the café
gallery.description: Take a closer look at the coffee bar, the drinks we make and what’s on the pastry counter.

items.question: Is there parking?
items.answer: Yes. You can park at the Khlong Rang Shell station and walk over to the café.

items.question: What coffee can I take home?
items.answer: We sell house blends, single-origin coffee, drip bags and coffee capsules. Ask at the bar what’s available today.

items.question: Can I try single-origin coffee?
items.answer: Yes. We rotate the single-origin coffee on our pour-over menu. If you prefer espresso, ask which beans are on the bar today.

items.question: Do you serve matcha and pastries?
items.answer: Yes. We serve matcha and bake our own scones, croissants and cakes. The pastry selection changes from day to day.
